relationships.subject: Cutibacterium acnes supernatant
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot validation confirmed that phosphorylated proteins in the MAPK pathway—p-p38, p-JNK, and p-ERK—were upregulated in a dose-dependent manner following C. acnes supernatant treatment

relationships.subject: Cutibacterium acnes supernatant
relationships.evidence_quote: exposure to C. acnes supernatant significantly decreased the expression of ECM synthesis-related proteins, including aggrecan and collagen II, while increasing the expression of matrix degradation enzymes MMP-13 and MMP-3

relationships.subject: BIRB-796
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis showed that BIRB-796 significantly inhibited the C. acnes supernatant-induced increase in p-p38 phosphorylation

relationships.subject: Wogonin
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis demonstrated that Wogonin significantly inhibited the phosphorylation of p38 (p-p38), JNK (p-JNK), and ERK1/2 (p-ERK1/2) induced by C. acnes supernatant

relationships.subject: Wogonin
relationships.evidence_quote: Wogonin mitigated ECM degradation by increasing aggrecan and collagen II expression while reducing MMP-13 and MMP-3 expression

key_findings: C. acnes supernatant induces oxidative stress, apoptosis and ECM degradation in NP cells via p38 MAPK activation.
Wogonin inhibits MAPK phosphorylation and alleviates C. acnes-induced disc degeneration in vitro and in rats.
